finding.evidence: no privacy policy, no information on the data collected by the checkout form
finding.description: Personal data is collected without the information the law requires.

recommendation.goal: What is the recommended fix for this web security flaw: missing-privacy-policy (Personal data is collected without the information the law requires. Evidence: no privacy policy, no information on the data collected by the checkout form). State the concrete fix and cite a primary source (OWASP, MDN, NIST, PCI DSS, IETF RFC, or the vendor's own advisory).
recommendation.answer: Fix: At collection, tell the user why the personal data is needed and how it is used. Encrypt stored private data with sufficient key lengths under strict technical and procedural access conditions. Dropped as unsupported in verified passages: footer-linked policy page, third-party/sharing/retention notice, consent, minimization, hashing.

sources.contribution: When an app requests personal information from a user, the user needs to know why the app needs that data and how it is used by the app.
Private data must be encrypted in storage using keys with sufficient lengths and under strict access conditions, both technical and procedural.

fix.summary: Add privacy notice at checkout and privacy policy on legal notice explaining purpose and use of collected data.
fix.risk: Extra informational HTML could alter page layout but no journey logic changed.

applied.replace:
return html(page('checkout.html') + `

Donnees personnelles : nom, email, adresse et carte collectes uniquement pour traiter et suivre votre commande. Conservation limitee a la gestion des commandes, sans partage.

`);

applied.find: if (path === '/mentions-legales') return html(page('mentions.html')); // FLAW 15 (compliance): no privacy policy, no cookie notice, personal data collected without information
